invariants.rationale: The context object is used to create a BaseRollbackPlanActionExecutor and must not be null.
instantTime is passed to the executor and should not be null to avoid errors.
instantToRollback is required by the rollback operation and must not be null for meaningful execution.
instantTime should specify a valid time, so it should not be an empty string.
If restore is in progress, rollback using markers may be mutually exclusive; commonly enforced in rollback scheduling semantics.
